python3 - <<'PY'
import json, time, urllib.request as u
def call(m, url, body=None):
    r = u.Request(url, method=m, data=None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode(), headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'})
    try:
        return json.load(u.urlopen(r, timeout=120))
    except u.HTTPError as e:
        return {'http_error': e.code}
Q = 'http://127.0.0.1:6333'
docs = ['restic restore latest --target DIR restores the newest backup snapshot into DIR',
        'Prometheus scrapes metrics from HTTP targets at a fixed interval',
        'Loki indexes log streams by label and stores chunks on the filesystem']
q = 'Instruct: Given a question, retrieve the passage that answers it\nQuery: how do I recover files from my latest backup?'
e = call('POST', 'http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/embed', {'model': 'qwen3-embedding:4b', 'input': [q] + docs})
v = e['embeddings']
n0 = len(call('GET', Q + '/collections')['result']['collections'])
name = 'nas_receipt_probe_%d' % int(time.time())
c = call('PUT', Q + '/collections/' + name, {'vectors': {'size': len(v[0]), 'distance': 'Cosine'}})
p = call('PUT', Q + '/collections/' + name + '/points?wait=true', {'points': [{'id': i + 1, 'vector': v[i + 1], 'payload': {'doc': i}} for i in range(len(docs))]})
s = call('POST', Q + '/collections/' + name + '/points/search', {'vector': v[0], 'limit': 3, 'with_payload': True})
hits = [(h['payload']['doc'], round(h['score'], 4)) for h in s.get('result', [])]
d = call('DELETE', Q + '/collections/' + name)
g = call('GET', Q + '/collections/' + name)
n1 = len(call('GET', Q + '/collections')['result']['collections'])
print('embedder', e.get('model'), 'dims', len(v[0]), '| create', c.get('result'), '| upsert', p.get('result', {}).get('status'), '| hits (doc, score)', hits, '| delete', d.get('result'), '| get after delete http', g.get('http_error'), '| collections before/after', n0, n1)
ok = c.get('result') is True and p.get('result', {}).get('status') == 'completed' and hits and hits[0][0] == 0 and d.get('result') is True and g.get('http_error') == 404 and n0 == n1
raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)
